cohort: 44 cases of prenatally diagnosed nuchal cord
finding: Prenatal diagnosis of nuchal cord is feasible but determining multiple loops is difficult; outcomes are favorable, but parental anxiety is common and may increase induction rates, without impacting cesarean rates or FHR abnormalities.
mod_finding: The primary cesarean rate was 34% (15/44), and instrumental vaginal delivery was used in 5 cases.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery was 39 weeks
